name: Meet Mahj Repeat
description: Beginner-focused American Mah Jongg group. Its own site: "Brand new to American Mah Jongg? Start here! Learn the tiles, decode the card, master the Charleston, and play a full game in a relaxed, supportive setting," and its classes cover reading the National Mah Jongg League card. Beginners Open/Guided Play runs with an instructor on hand at The Loft at MIMI + Clutch; four-week Mahj 101 series are listed separately. Open Play punch cards are sold online.
address: The Loft at MIMI + Clutch, 19 Belmont Street, North Easton, MA
schedule: Beginners Open/Guided Play, Monday and Wednesday evenings at 6:00 PM, $20 per night (dates listed on the club site)
